title: Rename Carcassonne to Tile Kingdoms (trademark)
description: 'Carcassonne' is trademarked by Hans im Glück. Rename to 'Tile Kingdoms' or similar generic name. Rename games/carcassonne.json to games/tile-kingdoms.json, update all references in tests, docs, and beads issues. Game mechanics (tile placement, meeple claiming, area scoring) are generic — only the name and specific tile art need to change.
